rongmei.title: Kagan hei na guang pu the

lines: 1. Kagan hei na guang pu the
Zian mei nunta tam khang,
Kandi arup jian mei nun le,
Zian mei nun ata mu ri o,
Ting sang ram gai guang tang pukhou.
Zianmei nun neila na tat ro,
Ntam dikho salam
Nang rih hu khou mai le muang rui,
Guang Immanual rui jailou diu.
2. Kandi rianra mei rui jing ,
Rian pui kandi hei,
Nzian mei nun ntam pui bam ,
Ting sang ram gai guang tang pukhou,
Hei kandi hei ning dat lak khe.
3. Kandi rianra dui dai khou,
Mikdui luang mei ruina ,
Achang hou mak nga bam khou hei,
Mikdui thut phuina dinlou o,
Tingsang ring nimei chang mun tei.
4. Zian mei nunta tam khou rui,
Mikdui luang mei ruina,
Dui kum na dailiam ngam kan the,
Kandi hei zing mei rana the.
Neilamei khuan chu dat mak khe.
5. Pou zan khou lum lou e thei,
Ntam kanmei guai le,
Guang jisu le bam cham puni,
Rianra mei mak pui ram khou tei.
6. Pou zan khou ntam lou na ,
Mikdui luang lou kanmei,
Guai rui kallou mei lapuni,
Khou tei rian ra mikdui keimei,
Guang jisu rui thut phui lou puni.
